info.name: Get static PNG render of token artwork

params.name: chainId
params.description: Chain ID of the network. Use 1 for Ethereum, 42161 for Arbitrum One, 8453 for Base.

params.name: contractAddress
params.description: Ethereum address of the Art Blocks core contract.

params.name: tokenId
params.description: The ERC-721 token ID (without .png extension in the parameter value).

items.docs: Returns a static PNG image of the Art Blocks token artwork, captured by a headless browser executing the generative script. This is the canonical static image used on artblocks.io and by NFT marketplaces for thumbnail display.
